question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: How many orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: What is the average price of our products?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products

question: List the names of all product categories.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM categories

question: How many customers are from India?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'India'

question: What is the name of the most expensive product?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many employees work in Engineering?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE department = 'Engineering'

question: What is the total salary paid in the Finance department?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(salary) FROM employees WHERE department = 'Finance'

question: How many products are out of stock?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE stock = 0

question: How many customers are in the Corporate segment?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE segment = 'Corporate'

question: What is the highest order total?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(total) FROM orders

question: How many different countries do our customers come from?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) FROM customers

question: How many orders were placed in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', created_at) = '2024'

question: How many products cost more than 100?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price > 100

question: Which employee earns the most?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders are still processing?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'processing'

question: How many customers signed up in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE strftime('%Y', signup_date) = '2023'

question: What is the cheapest product called?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1

question: How many users have the admin role?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'admin'

question: How many orders have a total above 500?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE total > 500

question: How many customers are there in each country?
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country

question: What is the total revenue from delivered orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'

question: How many products are in each category? Show the category name and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

question: What is the average order total for each customer country?
gold_sql: SELECT c.country, AVG(o.total) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.country

question: Which country has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT country FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Who are the top 3 customers by total order value?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(o.total) DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many orders were placed by customers in the Corporate segment?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.segment = 'Corporate'

question: What is the total quantity sold in each category? Show the category name and quantity.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

question: Which category generated the most revenue from order items (quantity times unit price)?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have never placed an order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

question: What is the average salary in each department?
gold_sql: SELECT department, AVG(salary) FROM employees GROUP BY department

question: Which department has the highest average salary?
gold_sql: SELECT department FROM employees GROUP BY department ORDER BY AVG(salary) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders are there in each status?
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: Which customers have placed more than 11 orders? List their names.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 11

question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2024? Show the month and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', created_at) = '2024' GROUP BY month

question: What are the top 5 products by total quantity sold?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many units of Electronics products were sold in total?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Electronics'

question: What is the average number of items per order?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(n) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question: Which customers from France placed an order over 600? List distinct names.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.country = 'France' AND o.total > 600

question: What is the total revenue in 2024 from orders that were not cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', created_at) = '2024' AND status <> 'cancelled'

question: How many products have fewer than 50 units in stock?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE stock < 50

question: List each department with its number of employees, largest first.
gold_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY department ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: What percentage of orders were cancelled? Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM orders

question: What is the total value of returned orders from Corporate customers?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.total) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'returned' AND c.segment = 'Corporate'

question: How many employees report directly to each manager? Show the manager name and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT m.name, COUNT(*) FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id

question: How many customers have a total order value above the average total order value per customer?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id, SUM(total) AS s FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) WHERE s > (SELECT AVG(s2) FROM (SELECT SUM(total) AS s2 FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id))

question: For each country, who is the top spending customer? Show country and customer name.
gold_sql: SELECT country, name FROM (SELECT c.country, c.name, SUM(o.total) AS spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.country ORDER BY SUM(o.total) DESC) AS rn FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id) WHERE rn = 1

question: Which month had the highest revenue in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) AS m FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', created_at) = '2024' GROUP BY m ORDER BY SUM(total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers placed orders in both 2023 and 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', created_at) = '2023' INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', created_at) = '2024')

question: Compare the average order total of customers who signed up in 2023 with those who signed up in 2024. Show the signup year and the average.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', c.signup_date) AS yr, AVG(o.total) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY yr

question: Which employees earn more than their manager? List their names.
gold_sql: SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.id WHERE e.salary > m.salary

question: Which product category has the highest average product price?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY AVG(p.price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders contain more than one distinct product?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) > 1)

question: Which three countries have the highest average order total? List them from highest to lowest.
gold_sql: SELECT c.country FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY AVG(o.total) DESC LIMIT 3

question: What fraction of customers have placed at least one order? Round to 3 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers), 3)

question: How many customers have bought products from at least 5 different categories?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) >= 5)

question: What is the name of the second most expensive Electronics product?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Electronics' ORDER BY p.price DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

question: Which year and month combination had the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) AS m FROM orders GROUP BY m ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average amount spent per customer in each segment? Count only customers who placed at least one order.
gold_sql: SELECT segment, AVG(s) FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, SUM(o.total) AS s FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id) GROUP BY segment

question: For each category, what is the name of the product with the highest total quantity sold?
gold_sql: SELECT category, product FROM (SELECT c.name AS category, p.name AS product, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY p.id) WHERE rn = 1

question: How many items were in cancelled orders in total?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
